run_flask_fallback_server: run the Flask fallback server on port 5000 using gevent WSGIServer
view_access_logs: view access logs from the view_logs endpoint with an access_key and optional timestamp filter
create_access_log_entry: create an access log JSON file when a non-internal host hits the main route
review_password_auth: review the password-based access control using access_key.txt for the view_logs endpoint
refactor_main_route: refactor the main_route to handle path routing and log non-internal host access
